# AdaptiveArchitecture

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability of a neural network to dynamically alter its own structural topology (e.g., adding/removing nodes or edges) during operation to match task demands. Bridges TCC and iNEST by enabling reconfigurable interconnect topologies that optimize communication and computation in situ, without offline redesign.
